guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：CERN 全球 LHC 運算網格
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: CERN Worldwide LHC Computing Grid
guides.concept: 以分層科學資料處理與跨機構計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect tiered scientific processing and interinstitutional computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「科學鏈路」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「探測器校正」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：重建輸出依賴校正與條件資料。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同一玩具事件用兩套校正比較。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「Tier-2 角色」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分散站點貢獻模擬與分析資源。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為玩具分析配置資料與計算位置。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「資料局部性」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：將計算移向資料可減少重複跨站傳輸。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具下載再算與近資料計算。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「複製策略」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：多副本提高可用性但增加儲存與流量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在三假想站點圖分析共同故障域。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「科學交付」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：交付應含資料範圍、統計誤差和處理版本。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific chains. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for detector calibration. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reconstruction depends on calibration and conditions data. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare one toy event under two calibrations. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for tier-2 roles. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Distributed sites contribute simulation and analysis resources. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Place toy analysis data and computation. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for data locality. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Moving compute toward data can reduce repeated transfers. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy download-then-compute with near-data work. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for replication policies. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Replicas improve availability but add storage and transfers. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Analyze shared failure domains across three fictional sites. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific delivery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Delivery includes data scope, statistical errors and processing versions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer reproduce self-made event histograms. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「結果交查」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「兩張圖相似就說明分析完全獨立。」為何不成立。
提交「科學交付」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。」如何辨別它們。
提交「科學交付」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「使用世界級網格保證所有科學結論正確。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for result cross-checks; explain why this claim fails: Similar plots prove fully independent analyses.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for scientific delivery; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for scientific delivery; explain why this claim fails: Using a world-class grid guarantees correct conclusions.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：使用世界級網格保證所有科學結論正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Using a world-class grid guarantees correct conclusions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
